content.value_statement: Complex processes are hard to explain when diagrams are inconsistent or invalid. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create readable Mermaid documentation.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable Mermaid diagram types for process, architecture, data, and interaction models.
Creates basic and styled Mermaid versions with readable labels and consistent colors.
Covers flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ERDs, state diagrams, Gantt charts, journeys, and timelines.
Adds rendering guidance, preview steps, export recommendations, and accessibility considerations.
Explains complex Mermaid syntax with comments when a diagram needs advanced structure.
limitations: It provides Mermaid source text, not a rendered image by itself.
It depends on the host assistant or user to test rendering in a Mermaid-compatible viewer.
It does not include extra reference files beyond SKILL.md in this package.
It may need complete process details to avoid vague diagrams.

use_cases.title: Document an API Flow
use_cases.description: Turn service interactions, authentication steps, and error paths into a sequence diagram for technical documentation.

use_cases.title: Map a Product Journey
use_cases.description: Convert onboarding steps, decisions, and handoffs into a readable flowchart for planning reviews.

use_cases.title: Model Data Relationships
use_cases.description: Represent entities, relationships, and key attributes as an ERD before schema or analytics work.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Flowchart
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple process diagram.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Mermaid flowchart for this process. Keep labels short and include a basic version plus a styled version: [paste process].

prompt_templates.title: Convert Process Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using rough notes or meeting output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these notes into the best Mermaid diagram type. Explain the choice, then provide basic and styled versions: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Design an Architecture Diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Mermaid architecture or flowchart diagram for these services, data stores, and dependencies. Include rendering notes and accessibility guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Full Diagram Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for complete documentation coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Mermaid diagram set for this feature. Include sequence, state, and ERD options with comments for complex syntax: [paste feature details].

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a login sequence with token validation and API access.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a sequence diagram plan, a basic Mermaid version, a styled version, and rendering notes.

output_examples.input: A product manager shares onboarding steps and decision points.
output_examples.output: The skill chooses a flowchart, simplifies labels, suggests colors, and notes where the process may be unclear.

output_examples.input: A data analyst lists customers, orders, products, and payment records.
output_examples.output: The skill creates an ERD structure, highlights relationship assumptions, and recommends checks before implementation.

best_practices: Provide the workflow, actors, systems, and expected audience before asking for a diagram.
Ask for both basic and styled versions when the diagram will be shared broadly.
Render the Mermaid output in your target viewer before publishing documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not request one large diagram when separate diagrams would be easier to read.
Do not omit edge cases, alternate paths, or unclear relationships.
Do not assume styling will render the same in every Mermaid viewer.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it render diagrams automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates Mermaid text and gives rendering guidance for compatible viewers.

faq.question: Which diagram types are supported?
faq.answer: It covers flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, ERDs, state diagrams, Gantt charts, journeys, and timelines.

faq.question: Can it help with architecture documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize services, dependencies, data stores, and interaction paths into Mermaid diagrams.

faq.question: Will it explain complex syntax?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for comments that explain complex Mermaid syntax.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide actors, steps, systems, decisions, relationships, and the audience for the diagram.
